summary: Learn to check datasets, run foundational statistical tests, and report results reproducibly in R. Explore the 10-day course outline.
lede: Statistical data analysis with R turns quantitative datasets into checked summaries and interpretable findings. It is for analysts, research staff, and programme teams who need to assess data before reporting results or informing decisions. You will practise importing and checking data, choosing and interpreting common statistical tests, and documenting findings with reproducible R scripts and Quarto reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with quantitative datasets and need to analyse them in R, explain statistical results, or check analysis before it reaches a report or decision-maker.
modules: Data Checks and Preparation in R
prerequisites: Basic computer and spreadsheet skills are helpful. No prior R programming experience is required. You should be comfortable working with rows, columns, and simple quantitative data.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
